correctness.rationale: In finite m+1 dimensional cooperative ODE with increasing concave C³ contamination h_i(0)=0 and q_i=h_i′(0)>0, the arrowhead Metzler Jacobian has Perron bound sign of R-1 where R=d/γ+Σ b_iq_i/(γδ_i). Concavity and scalar equilibrium relation yield unique positive endemic equilibrium iff R>1 and order-comparison global attraction. Linear dominance yields R<1 exponential clearance; positive linear left null vector and LaSalle gives R=1 global convergence. Strict convexity of Σa_i/δ_i gives unique KKT water-filling δ_i=max(d_i,sqrt(a_i/(λ c_i))) and unique finite B* if d<γ and baseline R>1. At R=1 the Perron/stable projection and quadratic nonlinear remainder yield V′=-(Λ/C²)V²+o(V²), with C=1+Σb_iq_i/δ_i², Λ=γ+Σ(b_i/δ_i)(q_i²/δ_i-h_i″(0)/2)>0; positivity excludes a purely exponentially stable orbit, so t x(t)→C/Λ, t y_i→(q_i/δ_i)C/Λ for every nonzero initial state. Independently verified two-class exact critical budget sqrt(2)-1/2, threshold index=1 and exact symbolic C/Λ expression; finite numerical runs not proof of t→∞.
residual_risks: Bounded finite checks are only corroboration; universal quantifiers follow from the cited analytic proof.
